rationale: C07 plausibly supplied a material template for the child’s board-creation and financing provisions. Both establish a presidentially constituted board, assign it an investigative/advisory function, and finance its work through a presidential allotment from the Emergency Fund. Most distinctively, their payment clauses use the same three-part waiver sequence naming section 3681, section 9 of the Act of March 4, 1909, and other laws later specified by the President. C10 has similarly close procedural and financing machinery, while C01 supplies the child’s distinctive alternate-member language, but neither matches as broad a combination of provisions as C07.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established a Clemency and Parole Board for War Criminals... The Board shall consist of three members, appointed by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby created a board to be known as the President's Communications Policy Board which shall be composed of a chairman and four other members to be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Both open by creating a small presidential board and specifying its presidentially selected membership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Board shall make the necessary investigation in, and advise the President with respect to, those cases
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It shall be the function of the Board to study... and to make and present to the President evaluations and recommendations
shared_material.explanation: Both assign the board an investigatory or evaluative role culminating in advice or recommendations to the President.
